name: 43205 · Columbus, OH
findings: ZIP 43205 (Columbus) has 154 nonprofit organizations. 57 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 48 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43205 (Columbus) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 43205 (Columbus) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 48 organizations here; 19% of all organizations here have no identified type.
